sourceFile: 2.BRS-161014  REPORT TEST  JIG Frame Array A JIG  UP version  date 28.10.2023_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: The report is comparable, but the draft misstates the baseline/change grouping and needs metric/header cleanup before final use.
issues: Baseline should be plastic JIG material, not an unspecified normal condition.
Changed condition should be steel JIG material after change, not both conditions combined.
Outcome domain and metric are too vague for spot-welding OK/NG and NG-rate results.
Header rows for OK, NG categories, total NG, and NG rate are not cited.
Row 34 supports an accept/use conclusion that is not reflected in judgement.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to JIG frame Array A material change from plastic to steel.
Set baselineCondition to JIG Material plastic and changedCondition to JIG after change Material steel.
Rename outcome to spot-welding inspection OK/NG and NG rate for JIG frame Array A.
Add V0!27 and V0!28 as evidence for metric headers.
Set judgement to passed/accepted with limitation that sample sizes differ.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are mostly sufficient for conditions and conclusion, but metric header rows must be added.
